attributes.source: permitted learn split, validation only; no official test

metadata.protocol: three alternating blocks; use saved fifth pass per block; ignore best_qps; warm four preceding passes

protocol.qps: query_count / sum(saved raw per-query fifth-pass times); best_qps ignored
protocol.selection: fastest measured median with minimum strict ID recall across repetitions >= target; no interpolation or rounding
protocol.epsilon_recall: float64 original-metric distance <= recomputed true kth distance + 0.001
protocol.resources: per-arm build seconds/encoded bytes where recorded; process RSS and VIBE USS delta aggregate all co-resident arms

resource_attrs.qag_mlann_construction: RF, n_trees=10, depth=14; same reserved-query exclusion as RoarGraph
resource_attrs.qag_mlann_query_copy: 32-byte aligned float32 buffer copy included in query timing
resource_attrs.qag_mlann_seed: uncontrolled std::random_device; one forest reused across repetitions
resource_attrs.qag_resource_scope: all built arms co-resident; VIBE index_size is aggregate USS delta, not per-arm peak RSS or serialized bytes
